_readme: ENTITY FACT REGISTRY — single source of truth (closes critique G23 / C8).
Rule: any number or name that appears on more than one surface is generated from here,
never typed. Surfaces that must agree: Organization JSON-LD (src/app/layout.js),
every brand page footer. `scripts/audit-brand-content.mjs` rule B14 fails the build
when a surface contradicts this file.
`brandCount` is NOT authored — it is asserted equal to allBrandsUnified.length at check time.

_boilerplateReadme: G14 (scripts/gates/g14-duplication.mjs) reads this list as the ONLY allow-listed
duplicate-sentence exceptions. <Placeholder> tokens are wildcards: a filled sentence
(e.g. 'Nu avem stoc permanent documentat pentru Grundfos; ...') still matches its template and is
exempted, whether or not the filled value happens to repeat across pages.
This list lives here, not in a writer-editable content file, so a content-writing
agent cannot grow the allow-list to launder a new duplicated sentence past G14 —
only an edit to entityFacts.json (an architecture-owned registry file) can.
